ddlStatements.createDataset: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS `keystone_intelligence` OPTIONS (location = 'US', labels = [("datacloud", "antigravity"), ("service", "keystone_intelligence")]);
ddlStatements.createEmbeddingModel: CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `keystone_intelligence.embedding_model` REMOTE WITH CONNECTION DEFAULT OPTIONS (ENDPOINT = 'text-embedding-005');
ddlStatements.createGenerativeModel: CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `keystone_intelligence.generative_model` REMOTE WITH CONNECTION DEFAULT OPTIONS (ENDPOINT = 'gemini-2.5-flash');
ddlStatements.createTableScrapedArchitectures: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures` (pattern_id STRING NOT NULL, source_url STRING NOT NULL, app_name STRING NOT NULL, inferred_domain STRING, component_summary STRING NOT NULL, component_tree JSON, design_tokens JSON, api_contracts JSON, workflow_patterns JSON, sha256_hash STRING NOT NULL, vault_token_ref STRING, structural_embedding ARRAY<FLOAT64>, extracted_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) PARTITION BY DATE(extracted_at) CLUSTER BY inferred_domain, app_name;

validQueries.tvfEmbeddingInFrom: SELECT base.pattern_id, emb.embedding FROM `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures` base, AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING(MODEL `keystone_intelligence.embedding_model`, (SELECT base.component_summary AS content), STRUCT('RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT' AS task_type, 768 AS output_dimensionality)) emb;
validQueries.vectorSearchInFrom: SELECT base.pattern_id, distance FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures`, 'structural_embedding', (SELECT embedding FROM query_emb), top_k => 5, distance_type => 'COSINE');
validQueries.aiGenerateInSelect: SELECT pattern_id, AI.GENERATE(CONCAT('Summarize: ', component_summary), endpoint => 'gemini-2.5-flash', output_schema => 'role STRING, task STRING, context ARRAY<STRING>, constraints ARRAY<STRING>, outputFormat STRING, reasoning STRING') AS synthesis FROM `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures`;
validQueries.aiClassifyInSelect: SELECT pattern_id, AI.CLASSIFY(component_summary, categories => ['software', 'creative', 'research', 'analytics', 'marketing', 'orchestration']) AS domain FROM `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures`;

invalidQueries.tvfEmbeddingInSelect: SELECT pattern_id, AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING(MODEL `keystone_intelligence.embedding_model`, (SELECT component_summary AS content)) AS embedding FROM `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures`;
invalidQueries.unquotedOutputSchema: SELECT pattern_id, AI.GENERATE('prompt', endpoint => 'gemini-2.5-flash', output_schema => role STRING) FROM `keystone_intelligence.scraped_architectures`;
